section.p: Answer a few questions to see whether you may qualify, then apply for one or both programs in a single application.

fg-set.question: Which benefits would you like to apply for?
fg-set.hint: You can apply for both in this one application.

fg-alert.heading: Choose at least one benefit
fg-alert.p: Select the benefits you would like to apply for before continuing.

fg-set.question: What is your ZIP code?
fg-set.hint: We use this to find the office that serves your area.

fg-set.question: About how much money did your household receive in the last 30 days?
fg-set.hint: Include wages, benefits and any other income. An estimate is fine.

fg-alert.heading: You may not qualify for food assistance
fg-alert.p: Based on what you have told us, your household income is above the amount we screen against. You can still submit an application, and the office that reviews it will make the final decision.

fg-alert.heading: You may qualify
fg-alert.p: Next we will ask about you, the people in your household, your income and your expenses. It helps to have pay stubs and immigration documents nearby.

modal-content.p: Count money from jobs, self-employment, unemployment, disability, Social Security, retirement, pensions and alimony. Do not count loans or one-off gifts.
